scripts.dev: npm run dev -w @gense/host-node & npm run dev -w @gense/web
scripts.dev:cf: npm run build && npm run dev -w @gense/host-cf
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/core && tsc -p packages/core/test && tsc -p hosts/node && tsc -p hosts/cf && npm run typecheck -w @gense/web
scripts.test: npm test -w @gense/core && npm test -w @gense/host-node && npm test -w @gense/host-cf
scripts.sandbox:build: docker build --network host --target slim -t gense-sandbox:slim sandbox && docker build --network host --target full -t gense-sandbox:full sandbox
